name: Webbed Extremities
body:
Webbed Extremities
Source Pathfinder #123: The Flooded Cathedral pg. 42
An alchemist with this discovery grows membranes between his fingers and toes, greatly improving his movement underwater. The alchemist gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Swim checks and can take 10 on a Swim check even if distracted or endangered while swimming.
